script: Relegation is coming to American soccer. The USL is creating a new top flight, USL Premier, above the Championship and League One. Teams move up, and teams go down, starting in 2028. But the bar is high: at least twelve teams, stadiums with fifteen thousand seats, and owners worth forty million dollars. Not enough teams have signed up yet. Should MLS do it too? Tell us in the comments.
caption:
Promotion and relegation is coming to US soccer. ⬆️⬇️

The USL is splitting into three divisions with a new top flight, USL Premier, and plans to introduce promotion and relegation in 2028.

The bar for a Division 1 league is high: at least 12 teams, enclosed stadiums with at least 15,000 seats, and owners worth $40M or more. So far, not enough teams have announced they will apply.

Should MLS do it too? Tell us in the comments 👇

Source: Goal, "USL announces rebrand" by Tom Hindle (Oct 23, 2026), citing the USL and U.S. Soccer's Division 1 standards. Cancha is independent and not affiliated with any league.
